exactSpeech:
Good afternoon. This is Grace from the Cedar Kitchen, calling about your Saturday lunch. You wanted the upstairs room so your team could run a short slide show. The elevator to that room will be out of service. If anyone needs step-free access, we can set up a screen in the garden room instead. Both rooms have the same menu.

I see that you’re bringing a cake. We can keep it in the fridge, but the kitchen staff can only take it in before eleven. Your friend is due at eleven thirty. If getting here before eleven is not possible, please ask her to keep the cake with her until you’re ready to serve it.

One more thing: we can put food on one bill and drinks on another. Individual bills are not available. Tell me which of those two bills should go to your office.
